title: Pointwise evaluation of the canonical identity pullback section
statement: For every Proj twisting sheaf, the section-normalized pullback comparison along the identity scheme map evaluates a section at the same point of the corresponding open.

source.place: Tags 01MY and 01N2, the identity pullback section normalization.

proof.text: Unfold the scalar-extension section and the section-normalized identity pullback comparison. The normalized adjunction identifies the pullback of a section along the identity with the original section, and evaluation on the identity preimage identifies the two points.

mathlib_searches.results: No existing theorem states the pointwise canonical identity evaluation.
mathlib_searches.verdict: The needed local section evaluation is split as a strictly smaller theorem.

mathlib_searches.results: Only generic pullback identity and section adjunction declarations found.

from.place: The section-level identity evaluation used in the canonical fraction normalization.

lean.statement:
theorem scalarExtension_twist_canonical_section
    {A : Type u} [CommRing A]
    {σ : Type u} [SetLike σ A] [AddSubgroupClass σ A]
    {𝒜 : ℕ → σ} [GradedRing 𝒜]
    (j : ℤ) (U : (Proj 𝒜).Opens)
    (s : Γ(twist 𝒜 j, U))
    (x : (𝟙 (Proj 𝒜)) ⁻¹ᵁ U) :
    ((scalarExtensionTwistSection (𝟙 (Proj 𝒜))
      (fun j ↦ (tensorPullbackSectionId (Proj 𝒜)).app (twist 𝒜 j)) j U s).1 x :
      Localization.AtPrime x.1.asHomogeneousIdeal.toIdeal) =
      (s.1 ⟨x.1, x.2⟩ : Localization.AtPrime x.1.asHomogeneousIdeal.toIdeal)
